name: Andi-User
description: Andi's user-triggered fetcher, which retrieves a page when someone searching on Andi asks for it. The operator documents it separately from Andi-SearchBot, which does the automatic crawling for Andi's index, and notes that short-form requests also go out for API and feed fetches such as a Wikipedia summary pulled in for a person. Like Andi-SearchBot it sends a From: hello+publishers@andiai.com header on page fetches.
